summary: Analysis/source-only block: rewrote AMPLIFIER.md as a rigorous lower-bound theorem and removed every statement that was too strong, with the retractions kept visible as A1-A8. Corrections: only the distinguished chain vertices p+j(q-p) are forced equal, not whole copies; the chain count is an inequality |C_n| <= nV-(n-1) because non-consecutive copies can overlap; the induced edge set has no upper bound, so 2nE+1 counts only the selected generating-edge multiset; D = 1/2 is permitted (antipodal ends are distinct and one unit apart) and the argument restricts to each injectively embedded copy, so overlaps are harmless; the (H4) upper-bound theorem is withdrawn, and an exactly (k+1)-chromatic finite subset is obtained instead by vertex-minimality with no extra hypothesis; the displacement v = q-p is used directly, so the rotation coefficients depend only on D^2 = n^2||v||^2 and no square root of ||v||^2 is ever adjoined, giving the field K(sqrt(4n^2||v||^2-1)) of degree at most 2; the claims about hardness/equivalence with the plane upper bound and about non-reversibility are deleted. Validated by reproducing the Moser spindle at k=3 (diamond, ||v||^2=3, n=1, cos theta=5/6, field Q(sqrt3,sqrt11), at most 7 points and 11 generating unit edges). No forcing pair exists in the project's evidence and none is asserted.
verified_results: GRADE [P] Theorem (lower bound): if G is a finite full induced unit-distance point graph with |P| = V, properly k-colourable, and p != q with c(p) = c(q) in every proper k-colouring, then for n with 4n^2||q-p||^2 >= 1 the induced unit-distance graph on X_n = (union_{j<n} P + j(q-p)) union R_theta(same) is not k-colourable. Proof: each isometric image P + jv is itself a copy of G (G being the full induced UDG), so the restricted colouring is a proper k-colouring and (H2) gives c(p+jv) = c(q+jv) = c(p+(j+1)v); induction makes the n+1 distinguished vertices monochromatic, and the two far ends nv and R_theta(nv) are distinct, at distance exactly 1.

GRADE [P] The rotation: with D = n||v|| and cos theta = 1 - 1/(2D^2), sin theta = sqrt(4D^2-1)/(2D^2), one has |nv - R_theta nv| = 2D sin(theta/2) = 1 exactly. Existence of a real theta is exactly D >= 1/2, i.e. 4n^2||v||^2 >= 1, an exact comparison in K; at D = 1/2 (theta = pi) the two ends are antipodal, distinct and one unit apart, so the boundary case is admissible.

GRADE [P] Corollary (exact chromatic number) via vertex-minimality: X_n is finite and not k-colourable, so a minimal subset Y with chi(Y) >= k+1 satisfies chi(Y-v) <= k for every v, hence chi(Y) <= k+1 and chi(Y) = k+1 exactly. No (H4)-type hypothesis and no claim that X_n itself is (k+1)-colourable.

GRADE [P] Counts and their direction: |C_n| <= nV - (n-1) and |X_n| <= 2nV - 2n + 1 (inequalities, since overlaps may occur); the generating edges form a multiset of exactly 2nE+1 entries whose distinct representatives number at most that, and the induced edge set is a superset of them, so no upper bound on |E(X_n)| is asserted. Size cost is O(V/||v||) points.

GRADE [P] Exact field: with P in K^2 and ||v||^2 in K, all chain coordinates lie in K^2 and the rotation coefficients lie in K(sqrt(4n^2||v||^2 - 1)), of degree at most 2 over K; no square root of ||v||^2 is needed because only D^2 = n^2||v||^2 is used. Every unit-distance and coincidence test is then an exact comparison in that field.

GRADE [P]+[C] Validation at k = 3: diamond with tips p = (1/2, sqrt3/2), q = (1/2, -sqrt3/2), ||v||^2 = 3 in Q, n = 1, cos theta = 5/6, sin theta = sqrt11/6, field Q(sqrt3, sqrt11) (the field of the record's exact spindle certificate), at most 7 points and 11 generating unit edges: the Moser spindle. The record certifies all eleven edges at squared length exactly 1 [C], so this instance has no accidental coincidence.
conjectures: The amplifier is a one-way interface: a forcing pair at k = 6 in a 6-colourable finite unit-distance graph would yield, by the Theorem plus vertex-minimality, a finite point subset with chromatic number exactly 7. That is the only implication proved; no converse, hardness or equivalence statement is claimed.

The only non-local obligation for any concrete use is (H2) - a statement about every proper k-colouring rather than one - and no evidence on file discharges it at any k, so the amplifier currently has no instance to run on.

Accidental edges cannot be excluded by genericity at the final step because theta is fixed by the unit-edge condition; they only strengthen the lower bound but may destroy (k+1)-colourability, which is why the upper bound is now obtained by vertex-minimality rather than from a colouring hypothesis.
